params.body:
`hand.mjs workingset --projects <slug,slug> [--layer B1|B2] [--days 1-7]` signs the owner's working set on the YubiKey (operator slot, PIN and touch, like `admit`) and hands it to Portal, which keeps it after checking the signature against the DID document. Inside the set, a passkey touch on Portal's Workbench page admits until the set ends.

The signed payload is canonical JSON:

```json
{"type": "working-set", "iss": "<DID>#operator", "sub": "<DID>", "projects": ["..."], "layer": "B2", "iat": 0, "exp": 0, "jti": "ws-..."}
```

It is refused before signing when it names no projects, reaches beyond B2, or stands longer than 7 days.

Depends on the Portal side (the working-set door).

Not tested with a real token here: the YubiKey is on the laptop. The arguments and refusals were checked on the workbench.
